$description: Nemo — Fixed pins. NOT sourced from Figma — these are a deliberate, hand-authored workaround for colors that must stay legible across both themes (a strong background + white text), for the exact hues where Figma's alias set never promoted an "On <Hue>" role (see CLAUDE.md, "Como os tokens funcionam", backlog item 6). Each entry just references an existing core.json primitive and pins it — it does not introduce a new color value. Naming mirrors the pre-existing Tailwind classes (primary-fixed, destructive-fixed, success-fixed, warning-fixed) that used to point straight at a primitive from inside tailwind.preset.js; this file promotes that pin to a real generated token so web/RN/Flutter all reference the same named thing instead of each reaching for the raw primitive independently. This is NOT the Figma "Fixed" role (which uses tone 90/80/10/30, always identical in both themes) — same name, different concept; don't conflate them.
